# Seattle.gov

> > Official City of Seattle government website providing public services, municipal court records, and real-time transportation information.

Seattle.gov serves as the primary digital gateway for Seattle residents and visitors to access city services, court records, traffic information, and municipal resources. The site is managed by the City of Seattle and provides essential public-facing tools and information.

## Key Topics

- Seattle Municipal Court
- Seattle Department of Transportation (SDOT)
- Court Records and Public Portal
- Real-time Traffic Information
- Bridge Status and Incident Alerts
- Traffic Cameras and Travel Times
- Browser Compatibility
- Public Services
- Transportation Infrastructure
- Municipal Government Services

## Transportation and Traffic

- [SDOT Travelers Home Page](http://web.seattle.gov/travelers/): SDOT real-time traffic map, cameras, bridge status & incident alerts

## Court Records and Legal Services

- [Seattle Municipal Court Public Portal](https://courtrecords.seattle.gov/): Seattle Municipal Court public records portal with browser compatibility
